text: In January, TEYCC approved my motion requesting that Metrolinx host an in‑person meeting with the community affected by the Gertrude Place Gate to discuss ongoing concerns related to truck access on Gertrude Place. At the in‑person meeting on February 11th, it was acknowledged that continued use of the Danforth gate remains operationally feasible, though it would require on‑site backing maneuvers and a flag person, resulting in longer processing times and higher project costs. Given these trade‑offs, it is essential that the contractor operate as a good neighbour to the surrounding community.
